_comment: Official PDFs, held as GitHub release assets rather than in git history.
Fetch them with: npm run rules:pdfs
Large PDFs are gitignored; their extracted text in extracted/ is committed,
and that text is what the verification pipeline actually reads.
Each entry pins a sha256 taken from the release asset digest.

release.note: Private repo — the public releases/download URL 404s. Fetch via the authenticated api.github.com asset endpoint; see scripts/rules-fetch-pdfs.mjs.
